about: Deuteronomy is Moses' goodbye talk. He reminds God's people to love God and obey Him in their new land.

pages.title: Love God with All Your Heart
pages.scene: A parent telling a child about God at bedtime
pages.text: Moses said, "Listen! The Lord is our God. Love Him with all your heart, all your soul and all your strength." He told parents to talk about God all the time: at home, on walks, at bedtime and when they wake up.
pages.lesson: Love God with all your heart.

pages.title: Choose Life
pages.scene: Moses talking to the people, pointing to two paths
pages.text: Moses said, "Today you can choose. You can follow God and be blessed. Or you can turn away from Him. Choose life! Love God, listen to Him and stay close to Him."
pages.lesson: Choose to follow God every day.

pages.title: Be Strong and Brave
pages.scene: Moses on a mountaintop looking at the promised land
pages.text: Moses was old. He told Joshua, "Be strong and brave. God will go with you. He will never leave you." Then God showed Moses the new land from the top of a mountain. Moses died, and Joshua became the new leader.
pages.lesson: Be strong and brave, because God never leaves you.
